data.raw_text:
[6:11PM] #Alausa_Ikeja #TrafficUpdate 

Good traffic movement on Obafemi Awolowo Way from Barrack, Radio, and Allen Junction to Olowu, but with increased traffic approaching Olowu and Ikeja underneath the bridge due to spillover from Ikeja Along overpass.
Busy traffic conditions approaching Allen Junction, Radio, and Barrack onward Olowopopo, particularly around traffic lights.
Smooth traffic flow on Mobolaji Johnson Avenue from Old Tollgate to Alausa Intersection, and on the stretch from Dr. Nurudeen Olowopopo to Otedola underneath the bridge.
Steady movement on Aromire linking Adeniyi Jones, Akora Villa to Hacco, with a good return journey, although busy approaching Allen Junction.
Good traffic movement on Lateef Jakande Road from Coca-Cola Junction to Mobil, Cadbury, and Agidingbi, but with increased traffic from First Gate, Wemco Junction to Omole Roundabout.

#FollowLASTMA

[6:50PM] #Idumota #TrafficUpdate 

High traffic influx inward journey from Eyin Eyo to Balogun Street.
Busy traffic conditions from Tinubu Square to Nnamdi Azikiwe Street, en route Carter Bridge via Tom Jones Intersection, due to market activities in the area.
Smooth traffic flow from Oyebanji Roundabout to Adeniji Adele Road, through Oba's Palace and Police Post.
Faster traffic movement at Illubinrin connecting Carter Bridge, inward journey to Ijora Olopa, as well as Oyingbo.

#FollowLASTMA
